# Askmydocsai

> Askmydocsai is a high-performance Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform powered by FastAPI, React 18, PostgreSQL with pgvector (1024-dim), Redis ephemeral caching, Groq inference acceleration (Qwen 3.6 / Llama 3.3), and Jina AI CLIP embeddings.

## System Capabilities
- **Multi-Tenant Document RAG**: Partitioned knowledge bases isolated by organization ID (`org_id`).
- **Hybrid Search Engine**: Dense vector similarity search combined with full-text BM25 and exact keyword matching.
- **Dynamic Query Modes**:
  - `Global Mode`: Queries enterprise-wide indexed documents with citation tracking.
  - `Sandbox / Local Mode`: Ephemeral isolated document sessions cached in Redis with a 1-hour TTL.
  - `Hybrid Mode`: Combined reasoning across global enterprise knowledge and session-specific uploads.
- **Streaming Real-Time Responses**: Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming with sub-second time-to-first-token.
- **Enterprise Authentication**: Email/Password with strong password criteria, JWT tokens, and Google OAuth 2.0.

## API Endpoints for Agents
- **API Documentation**: [FastAPI Swagger UI](https://api.askmydocsai.dpdns.org/docs)
- **OpenAPI Schema**: [OpenAPI JSON](https://api.askmydocsai.dpdns.org/openapi.json)
- **Health Check**: `GET https://api.askmydocsai.dpdns.org/health`
- **Chat Query Endpoint**: `POST https://api.askmydocsai.dpdns.org/api/query` (SSE text/event-stream)
- **Document Ingestion**: `POST https://api.askmydocsai.dpdns.org/api/ingest`

## Architecture & Design
- **Frontend Architecture**: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 featuring AMD-inspired dark minimalism, flowing light particle aesthetics, and accessible responsive interfaces.
- **Security & Privacy**: Zero data leakage, strict tenant scoping, and SHA-256 deduplication hashing.
